technical.summary: Mixed short-term momentum (RSI rising, DC10 breakout) conflicts with intermediate bearish structure (below 50/200 EMAs, negative MACD, below cloud); weak trend strength (ADX 12.22) and neutral sector momentum limit swing entry probability.

fundamental.summary: ACN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 65 days adds timing risk with no offsetting fundamental catalysts.

sentiment.congressional_conviction: low — small to medium amounts, mixed party members
sentiment.summary: Mixed congressional activity with no composite signal; broad market fear (36/100) presents potential contrarian opportunity, but lack of recent news data and neutral AAII sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (349.6), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising dollar pressuring multinational earnings, with earnings event 65 days out adding binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI 9/14 rising with Donchian 10 breakout provides short-term momentum entry signal, and broad market fear (36/100) creates potential contrarian opportunity for tactical swing.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, rising dollar), price below both 50/200 EMAs with negative MACD, below Ichimoku cloud, weak ADX trend confirmation, and high earnings risk in 65 days eliminate swing entry probability despite short-term momentum.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term RSI momentum and Donchian breakout offer tactical entry, but macro environment (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, rising dollar) and price structure (below 50/200 EMAs, negative MACD, below cloud) create asymmetric risk unsuitable for swing trade.
decision.primary_risk: VIX in crisis territory combined with 65-day earnings event creates binary downside risk that outweighs short-term momentum; existing ACN position and 3 other IT holdings amplify sector concentration risk.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case; technical weakness, fundamental void, and macro headwinds converge
decision.portfolio_note: Existing ACN position plus 3 other IT holdings in 34-position portfolio already create sector concentration; skip preserves capital in unfavourable macro environment.
